summary: Read-only inspection of the deployed rules for gerenciador-de-times-matoreal on 2026-10-25 (America/Sao_Paulo): adminProfiles is protected, but all other top-level collections permit public reads and writes. No production rules were changed.

findings.issue: The recursive fallback allows unauthenticated create, update and delete outside adminProfiles, including players, matches and any new settlement ledgers. Frontend role checks cannot enforce the requested journal restriction.
findings.recommendation: Migrate legacy identities and affected actions to authenticated server endpoints; explicitly exclude protected collections from the permissive fallback before activating automatic results. Test unauthorized writes in the Firestore emulator.

findings.issue: Only ADM accounts currently use Firebase Auth. Replacing all public writes with auth-required rules immediately would break existing player, team and staff flows.
findings.recommendation: Stage a compatible authentication migration and server ownership of progression, standings, fixtures and disciplinary data before tightening the production rules.

findings.check: Update Bypass / Type Safety / Storage Abuse
findings.issue: Public collections have no create/update schema, size or immutable-field checks. Users can bypass both validation and ownership for game data.
findings.recommendation: Specify schemas and bounded fields per collection, enforce ownership for permitted client edits, and reserve XP, career statistics and match effects for validated server operations.
